final: SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_total_rebate, AVG(rebrate / feerate) AS avg_rebate_fee_ratio, AVG(rebrate / feerate) / (SELECT AVG(order_avg_ratio) FROM (SELECT AVG(rebrate / feerate) AS order_avg_ratio FROM fees WHERE rebrate >= 0.0005 GROUP BY orderslink)) AS relative_ratio FROM fees WHERE rebrate >= 0.0005 GROUP BY orderslink HAVING (SELECT AVG(order_avg_ratio) FROM (SELECT AVG(rebrate / feerate) AS order_avg_ratio FROM fees WHERE rebrate >= 0.0005 GROUP BY orderslink)) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY relative_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
